integrity: The mathematical proof, stated boundaries, verification scripts, and recorded output are provided. The claimed generalized-quadrangle count is conditional on existence of the quadrangle. No claim of independent review.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple bipartite graphs with diameter exactly four and girth at least eight, equipped with unscaled graph distance; no claim about generalized hexagons, other distance metrics, symmetry representations or independent certification. The full-scale result is proved by explicit simplicial join/collapse and a previously published graph-power stability theorem; finite scripts only cross-check examples. The 256-sphere order-two case is prior work.
title: The radius-three Rips join theorem for girth-eight diameter-four bipartite graphs
